description: This file defines the AutoScalingPlansClient class, which is a client used to interact with the AWS Auto Scaling Plans service via the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various operations like creating, deleting, describing, and updating scaling plans, as well as fetching forecast data.

classes.name: AutoScalingPlansClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS Auto Scaling Plans service, extending the base AwsClient to include specific methods for managing scaling plans and retrieving forecast data.

methods.name: createScalingPlan
methods.description: Creates a new Auto Scaling plan.

methods.name: createScalingPlanAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new Auto Scaling plan.

methods.name: deleteScalingPlan
methods.description: Deletes an existing Auto Scaling plan.

methods.name: deleteScalingPlanAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an Auto Scaling plan.

methods.name: describeScalingPlanResources
methods.description: Describes the resources associated with a scaling plan.

methods.name: describeScalingPlanResourcesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes the resources associated with a scaling plan.

methods.name: describeScalingPlans
methods.description: Provides details about existing scaling plans.

methods.name: getScalingPlanResourceForecastData
methods.description: Retrieves forecast data for a scaling plan resource.

methods.name: getScalingPlanResourceForecastDataAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves forecast data for a scaling plan resource.
